title: Can I WIN 3+ Chess Tournament?
summary: chess.com Three-Check (3+) Swiss tournament, 1-minute games, planned 9 rounds but reduced to 7. He wins rounds 1-4 and 6 (mostly by delivering three checks), loses round 5 to a much higher-rated opponent by checkmate, wins the last round to score 6/7 but finishes second on tiebreak.
rules: Three-Check chess: standard chess, but you also win by putting the opponent's king in check three times (check counter per side).
Time control 1+0 (bullet); Swiss tournament scoring 1 point per win.
win_condition: Deliver 3 checks or checkmate (or flag). Video: tournament points (6/7, 2nd place).

opponent.name: Online humans (~1550-1950; e.g. BRUttines? ~1944)
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com default avatars; tournament score (3.0) beside names.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board, check counters (+ icons) beside names, tournament standings.

events: Check counter increments on each check
current_impl_issues: Current impl is a plain 3+2 clock gauntlet - wrong: the '3+' is Three-Check chess (win on third check) at 1-minute time control.

Time control is 1 and there are nine rounds'; [01:53] 'reduced to seven rounds'; 'check number three wins us round number four'; 'checkmate to lose game number five'; 'scored six out of seven... we do end up in second place'.
